Institutional foundations
The principles that guide Universidad de Dagupan.
Our philosophy, vision, mission, and objectives define how we educate, serve, and contribute to the wider community.
Explore our academic programs
Philosophy
The institution believes that through education, man's God-given gifts are discovered and developed for his personal fulfillment and community uplift.
Vision
It Invisions to create a community responsive to the challenges of the changing world.
Mission
It is tasked to prepare the individuals with the best that education can offer in a manner that is consistent with the needs of society.
Objectives
Inculcate critical thinking; provide competent human resources; promote discipline, justice, and equality; improve quality of life through research and community service.
Quality commitment
EOMS Policy
The Universidad de Dagupan shall be known as an educational institution that discovers and develops God-given gifts to help achieve man's personal fulfillment and community uplift.
We shall continue to maintain our innovation efforts with the potential to create solutions and to be an invaluable national treasure. We shall commit to providing satisfactory service delivery and comply with applicable requirements in view of the educational, scientific, and technical developments.
We shall unceasingly improve our instruction, research, extension, and administrative operations to provide excellent education to individuals and communities responsive to the challenges of the changing world.
ISO 21001:2018-certified educational management system

Admissions guide
Your path to Universidad de Dagupan.
Follow these steps and prepare the essential
requirements for your journey at Universidad de Dagupan.
Requirements
Form 137
Form 138
Good Moral Character
PSA Birth Certificate
OTR Copy for UdD (Transferee)
A simple four-step guide
01
Enlistment
Submit requirements and initiate enlistment forms.
02
Admissions
Settle the required admission and initial tuition fees.
03
Scheduling
Get your subjects scheduled and secure registration.
04
Identification
Capture your official photo and receive school ID.
Begin your UdD journey
Our dedicated admissions team is
standing by to guide you through every phase of the enrollment process. Join a community built on a
42-year heritage of excellence.

SDG 17 - PARTNERSHIPS FOR THE GOALS
Universidad de Dagupan Partners with DTI Pangasinan for Digital Transformation and Student Upskilling
By UdD Staff
Jul 9, 2026
Share
Universidad de Dagupan (UdD) and the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) – Pangasinan formally strengthened their partnership through the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) aimed at providing students with greater opportunities for skills development, digital innovation, and career readiness.
Representing the University during the signing ceremony was Chief Operating Officer Sir Jann Alfred Arzadon Quinto, while the DTI delegation was led by Natalia B. Dalaten, Acting Assistant Regional Director and Provincial Director, together with Atty. Joseph Manuel P. Pamittan, Chief Trade and Industry Specialist of the Business Development Division.
The signing ceremony was held earlier today at the University's Audio-Visual Theatre (AVT) and was witnessed by the University's deans, department heads, faculty members, and students, signifying the shared commitment of both institutions to advancing education and industry collaboration.
The partnership supports DTI's initiatives under the Internet Transactions Act of 2023 and the E-Commerce Philippines 2028 Roadmap, promoting digital transformation, e-commerce education, and workforce upskilling. Through this collaboration, UdD students will gain access to learning opportunities, training programs, and extracurricular activities that will equip them with in-demand digital skills and prepare them for future careers.
The MOU also highlights the importance of public-private partnerships in bridging education and industry, empowering students with practical knowledge while contributing to the country's growing digital economy.
This collaboration reaffirms Universidad de Dagupan's commitment to providing quality education and meaningful industry partnerships that prepare students to become competent, innovative, and future-ready professionals.
CLICK THIS LINK

UdD-SITE Soars to the Nationals at HackForGov 5!
By UdD Staff
Aug 25, 2026
Share
Universidad de Dagupan’s School of Information Technology Education (SITE) once again made its mark at HackForGov 5, held on August 19, 2026, in Bantay, Ilocos Sur.
Among 10 teams from across Region 1, CyberOwls Beta secured 1st Runner-Up with 820 points, while CyberOwls Alpha finished fifth.
𝐖𝐈𝐋𝐃𝐂𝐀𝐑𝐃 𝐓𝐎 𝐓𝐇𝐄 𝐍𝐀𝐓𝐈𝐎𝐍𝐀𝐋𝐒 🇵🇭

We also proudly recognize the members of CyberOwls Alpha:
Marianne Charesse Cali, Zernan Vash Arive, and Lizmer Aleda Santillan.
𝐑𝐄𝐆𝐈𝐎𝐍𝐀𝐋 𝟏𝐒𝐓 𝐑𝐔𝐍𝐍𝐄𝐑-𝐔𝐏 🥈
Congratulations to CyberOwls Beta:
Ana Victoria Alentajan, Clarissa Angel Gutlay, Lance Joseph De Vera, and Alyana Soriano.
Both teams proudly represented UdD and demonstrated excellence in web exploitation, cryptography, digital forensics, network analysis, and OSINT.
Special recognition to their dedicated coach, Mr. Marc France P. Cabiles, for guiding and preparing our CyberOwls throughout the competition.
Two teams. One regional podium finish. One ticket to the Nationals.
Congratulations, CyberOwls!

Binibining Universidad de Dagupan 2024: The Grand Coronation
By UdD Staff
April 12, 2024
Share
The Universidad de Dagupan (UdD) recently held its much-anticipated Binibining Universidad de Dagupan 2024 pageant, a night filled with beauty, grace, and intelligence. The event was a resounding success, showcasing the talent and potential of UdD's binibinis.
The pageant saw a group of talented and confident young women compete in various segments, including evening gown, best in production number, question-and-answer, and a lot more. Each contestant displayed their unique strengths and personalities, captivating the audience with their poise, eloquence, and passion. Amongst those young and beautiful women was the one and only, Miss Earth Air 2023, Yllana Marie Aduana, who lent her expertise and inspiration to the aspiring beauty queens as one of the special guest judges of the night.
The whole gymnasium cheered with excitement and anticipation as the judges punctiliously select a worthy successor to the Binibining Universidad de Dagupan crown.
After a dazzling display of brilliance and poise, the esteemed judges finally awarded the prestigious crown to the radiant Allyssa Marie Tucay, from the esteemed School of Business and Accountancy, crowning her Binibining Universidad de Dagupan 2024. Of course, the one crowning her is none other than Donna Rein Nuguid, who was Binibining Universidad de Dagupan 2023, also reigning from the School of Business and Accountancy. The momentous night continued as other impressive awards were presented to the participants, recognizing their incredible talents and achievements.
Beyond the glitz and glamor, the Binibining Universidad de Dagupan pageant served as a platform for empowering young women. The contestants not only showcased their beauty and talent but also advocated for various social causes and demonstrated their commitment to academic excellence and community service.
The event concluded with a sense of pride and accomplishment for all involved. The newly crowned Binibining Universidad de Dagupan and her court will undoubtedly serve as inspiring role models for the UdD community, promoting confidence, leadership, and a dedication to making a positive impact on the world.
Photo courtesy: Kurt Denzel A. Caranyagan

Hear the Roar of the Savannah! Universidad de Dagupan Cheerdance Competition 2024 Electrifies Universidad de Dagupan Intramurals
By UdD Staff
April 13, 2024
Share
Hear the Roar of the Savannah! Universidad de Dagupan Cheerdance Competition 2024 Electrifies Universidad de Dagupan Intramurals
The Universidad de Dagupan Intramurals 2024 roared with excitement as the Cheerdance Competition 2024 took center stage. The event showcased the athleticism, teamwork, and vibrant spirit of the UdD community, leaving the audience in awe with electrifying performances.
Competing teams brought their best, displaying intricate formations, synchronized stunts, and high-energy routines. The atmosphere was electric as cheers erupted from the crowd, each team vying for the coveted championship title.
The competition served as a platform for students to showcase their talents and dedication to their respective colleges and departments. The synchronized movements, powerful stunts, and infectious enthusiasm were a testament to the hard work and commitment of each team.
Beyond the competitive spirit, the Cheerdance Competition fostered a sense of unity and camaraderie within the UdD community. Students came together to support their teams, creating a vibrant and energetic atmosphere that transcended departmental boundaries.
As the competition concluded, the judges crowned the champions, recognizing the outstanding performances and unwavering dedication of The School of Information Technology Education (SITE) , solidifying their reign as back-to-back champions from last year's cheerdance competition. The crowd erupted in a thunderous roar as SITE students celebrated their victory. The event left a lasting impression on everyone involved, further solidifying the importance of teamwork, sportsmanship, and school spirit within the UdD community.

40 Years of UdD Excellence: UdD launches their first ever Coffee Table Book!
By UdD Staff
March 9, 2024
Share
The University of Dagupan (UdD) is celebrating its 40th anniversary in grand style with the launch of its very first coffee table book! This commemorative publication promises to be a visual and historical journey through the institution's remarkable journey, showcasing its achievements, milestones, and the impact it has made on the community.
Since its establishment in 1984, UdD has grown from a small college to a full-fledged university, consistently striving for academic excellence and fostering a vibrant campus culture. The coffee table book will serve as a testament to this growth, capturing the essence of UdD's legacy through captivating photographs, insightful stories, and detailed accounts of its evolution.
This special publication is expected to be a valuable resource for students, alumni, faculty, and the wider community. It will offer a glimpse into UdD's rich history, highlighting the dedication of its founders, the contributions of its faculty and staff, and the achievements of its students.
The launch of the coffee table book marks a significant moment for UdD, not only commemorating its 40th Ruby anniversary but also providing a tangible record of its journey and accomplishments. This visually stunning publication is sure to become a cherished keepsake for everyone connected to the university, serving as a source of inspiration and pride for generations to come.
photo courtesy: Landeil M. Robles

Universidad de Dagupan Steals the Spotlight at Higher Education Institution and Career Fair
By UdD Staff
May 26, 2023
Share
The Universidad de Dagupan (UdD) made a resounding impact at the recent Higher Education Institution (HEI) Career Fair held at the CSI Stadia in Dagupan City. Themed "Tagumpay Mo Kabataan, Pangarap ng Dagupan" (Your Success, Dagupan's Dream), the two-day event provided a valuable platform for graduating high school students to explore their academic options and connect with potential career paths.
UdD wasn't alone in its mission. The fair bustled with energy as numerous colleges and universities from the region showcased their diverse academic programs. Informative booths and engaging presentations offered students a glimpse into various fields of study, from engineering and business to medicine and the arts.
UdD's delegation showcased the university's diverse academic programs through interactive booths and presentations. Faculty members and current students engaged with the enthusiastic crowd, answering questions about admissions, scholarships, and student life.
UdD's participation in the HEI Career Fair went beyond simply promoting its programs. The university actively contributed to the event's mission of empowering young minds. By providing insightful guidance and showcasing its vibrant campus culture, UdD made a lasting impression on future generations, inspiring them to pursue their academic aspirations and contribute to the city's bright future.

UdD Expands International Engagement at China International Fair for Trade in Services 2026
By UdD Staff
Sep 15, 2026
Share
Universidad de Dagupan (UdD) participated in the 2026 China International Fair for Trade in Services (CIFTIS) held on September 9–13, 2026, in Beijing, China, as part of the Philippine higher education delegation, with Philippine higher education institutions represented through the Philippine exhibition/pavilion and related education-services engagements. Representing Universidad de Dagupan were University President Dr. Feliza Arzadon-Sua and Dr. Gef Arzadon-Quinto III, Member of the Board of Trustees, who joined fellow Philippine higher education institutions in promoting Philippine higher education and exploring opportunities for international academic and institutional partnerships.
The Philippine higher education delegation was headed by Dr. Jimmy G. Catanes, Director IV of the Office of Programs and Standards Development (OPSD), Commission on Higher Education (CHED). The delegation was also honored by the presence of His Excellency Jaime A. FlorCruz, Philippine Ambassador to the People’s Republic of China, together with his wife, Mrs. Ana Segovia FlorCruz, highlighting the shared commitment to strengthening educational, institutional, and people-to-people ties between the Philippines and China.
Through its participation in CIFTIS, UdD engaged with international institutions and stakeholders, promoted the University and Philippine higher education, and explored potential collaborations in student and faculty mobility, research, academic exchanges, and other international education initiatives. UdD’s participation reflects its continuing commitment to strengthening its global presence, expanding international partnerships, and creating greater opportunities for its students, faculty, and academic community.

Universidad de Dagupan Secures Spot in Enactus Philippines National Top 60
By UdD Staff
Sep 9, 2026
Share
From more than 200 entries from schools across the Philippines, we are proud and excited to announce that Universidad de Dagupan (UdD) has secured a spot among the TOP 60 schools advancing to the Enactus Philippines 2026 Early-Stage Project Competition Track!
This remarkable achievement highlights the creativity, ingenuity, and entrepreneurial spirit of our students as they take their project to the next level toward the Enactus Philippines National Competition & Innovation Summit 2026, happening on October 9–10, 2026, at De La Salle University, Manila.
Representing UdD is NursePath—an offline-first clinical reference companion designed for Filipino nursing students, created by Rance Adriel Pascua, BS Nursing student, Jhomar Salazar and Francine Nicole De Guzman, both BS Information Technology students along with their coach, Mr. Edberg De Guzman.
More than a project, NursePath reflects our students’ commitment to using innovation and technology to address real challenges in Nursing education and help make learning more accessible, practical, and responsive to the needs of future nurses.
From the classrooms of Dagupan to a national stage, our students are proving that great ideas can come from anywhere—and that innovation becomes more meaningful when it is driven by purpose and service.
Congratulations to our NursePath team! Your UdD family is immensely proud of you.
The journey continues. The national stage awaits.

UdD, PAGE Philippines Formalize Partnership for Academic and Research Advancement
By UdD Staff
Aug 28, 2026
Share
Universidad de Dagupan (UdD) and the Philippine Association for Graduate Education (PAGE) Philippines, Inc. formalized an institutional partnership through the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) aimed at strengthening graduate education.
The MOU was signed by UdD President Dr. Feliza Arzadon-Sua and PAGE Philippines, Inc. National President Dr. Lino C. Reynoso, with Dr. Caridad Oli Abuan, Dean of the School of Professional Studies, as witness.
The partnership promotes collaboration in research, scholarship, professional development, curriculum innovation, and the sharing of academic resources and expertise, creating opportunities for educators, researchers, graduate students, and professionals.

SDG 17 - PARTNERSHIPS FOR THE GOALS
𝗨𝗱𝗗, 𝗗𝗧𝗜 𝗣𝗮𝗻𝗴𝗮𝘀𝗶𝗻𝗮𝗻 𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗴𝗲 𝗽𝗮𝗿𝘁𝗻𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝘁𝗵𝗿𝗼𝘂𝗴𝗵 𝗠𝗢𝗨 𝘀𝗶𝗴𝗻𝗶𝗻𝗴
By UdD Staff
Jul 9, 2026
Share
Universidad de Dagupan (UdD) and the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) – Pangasinan formally strengthened their partnership through the signing of a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) aimed at providing students with greater opportunities for skills development, digital innovation, and career readiness.
Representing the University during the signing ceremony was Chief Operating Officer Sir Jann Alfred Arzadon Quinto, while the DTI delegation was led by Natalia B. Dalaten, Acting Assistant Regional Director and Provincial Director, together with Atty. Joseph Manuel P. Pamittan, Chief Trade and Industry Specialist of the Business Development Division.
The signing ceremony was held earlier today at the University's Audio-Visual Theatre (AVT) and was witnessed by the University's deans, department heads, faculty members, and students, signifying the shared commitment of both institutions to advancing education and industry collaboration.
The partnership supports DTI's initiatives under the Internet Transactions Act of 2023 and the E-Commerce Philippines 2028 Roadmap, promoting digital transformation, e-commerce education, and workforce upskilling. Through this collaboration, UdD students will gain access to learning opportunities, training programs, and extracurricular activities that will equip them with in-demand digital skills and prepare them for future careers.
The MOU also highlights the importance of public-private partnerships in bridging education and industry, empowering students with practical knowledge while contributing to the country's growing digital economy.
This collaboration reaffirms Universidad de Dagupan's commitment to providing quality education and meaningful industry partnerships that prepare students to become competent, innovative, and future-ready professionals.

SDG 17 - PARTNERSHIPS FOR THE GOALS
Universidad de Dagupan Achieves Region I First as FoodSHAP Authorized Course Provider
By UdD Staff
Jun 26, 2026
Share
𝗨𝗱𝗗 𝗯𝗲𝗰𝗼𝗺𝗲𝘀 𝗥𝗲𝗴𝗶𝗼𝗻 𝟭'𝘀 𝗳𝗶𝗿𝘀𝘁 𝗙𝗼𝗼𝗱𝗦𝗛𝗔𝗣 𝗔𝘂𝘁𝗵𝗼𝗿𝗶𝘇𝗲𝗱 𝗖𝗼𝘂𝗿𝘀𝗲 𝗣𝗿𝗼𝘃𝗶𝗱𝗲𝗿
Universidad de Dagupan (UdD) and FoodSHAP officially signed a Memorandum of Agreement (MOA), making UdD the first institution in Region I to become a FoodSHAP Authorized Course Provider. The partnership marks a significant milestone in advancing food safety education in the region while reinforcing the University's commitment to producing globally competitive professionals. Representing the institutions were UdD President Dr. Feliza Arzadon-Sua and FoodSHAP Managing Director Elsie Gatpayat, FSCO.
The agreement formally authorizes UdD to offer the Food Safety Training & Examination System (FSTES) Programs leading to FoodSHAP Qualifications, providing students and industry practitioners with access to internationally recognized food safety certifications. The partnership recognizes FoodSHAP as the national provider of the Food Safety Training & Examination System (FSTES), responsible for authorizing institutions to deliver course programs leading to FoodSHAP Qualifications. As the first institution in Region I to establish this partnership, UdD further strengthens its role as a leader in delivering industry-aligned education and workforce development initiatives. Also present during the signing were Dr. Justin Frances Q. Callesto, UdD Vice President for Administration and Finance and Dean of the School of International Hospitality Management; Mr. John Marc Lomibao, Program Head of the School of International Hospitality Management; and Ms. KC Cadano-Salcedo, FSCO, FoodSHAP Program Partnership Manager.
The collaboration reflects both institutions' shared commitment to promoting excellence in food safety education through accessible, competency-based training and certification programs. By becoming a FoodSHAP Authorized Course Provider, UdD expands learning opportunities that enhance professional competence, uphold food safety standards, and prepare graduates for careers in the hospitality, food service, and allied industries. The MOA signing was held today at Primeland Building, Market Street, Madrigal Business Park, Ayala Alabang, Muntinlupa City, marking another milestone in Universidad de Dagupan's pursuit of academic excellence and strategic industry partnerships.
Back to All News

Pamaskong Handog 2023: Spreading Holiday Cheer One Blessing at a Time.
By UdD Staff
December 13, 2023
Share
The Universidad de Dagupan (UdD) ushered in the holiday season with its heartwarming "Pamaskong Handog 2023" initiative, organized by the Supreme Student Council under the theme "Liwanag ng Pasko, Kasiyahan sa Bawat Puso" (Light of Christmas, Joy in Every Heart). This event served as a beautiful reminder of the importance of compassion, generosity, and the spirit of giving during the festive season.
UdD's "Pamaskong Handog" brought together students, faculty, and staff in a collective effort to bring joy and support to those in need. The initiative involved various activities, including giving gifts to ones in need. UdD prepared and distributed gift packages filled with essential items and holiday treats to underprivileged families and individuals in the community.
The impact of "Pamaskong Handog 2023" extended far beyond the material gifts. The event fostered a strong sense of unity and compassion within the UdD community. Students, faculty, and staff came together as a single unit, dedicating their time and effort to make a positive difference in the lives of others. This spirit of giving truly embodied the essence of the holiday season.
"Pamaskong Handog" left a lasting impression on everyone involved. It served as a powerful reminder of the joy that comes from giving back and the importance of spreading holiday cheer during this special time of year. The initiative is a testament to UdD's unwavering commitment to social responsibility and its dedication to making a positive impact on the community.

UdD Strengthens Global Education Partnerships Through Courtesy Call with Philippine Ambassador to the UK
By UdD Staff
Jun 2, 2026
Share
𝗨𝗱𝗗 𝗣𝗿𝗲𝘀𝗶𝗱𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗷𝗼𝗶𝗻𝘀 𝗖𝗼𝘂𝗿𝘁𝗲𝘀𝘆 𝗖𝗮𝗹𝗹 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗣𝗵𝗶𝗹𝗶𝗽𝗽𝗶𝗻𝗲 𝗔𝗺𝗯𝗮𝘀𝘀𝗮𝗱𝗼𝗿 𝘁𝗼 𝘁𝗵𝗲 𝗨𝗻𝗶𝘁𝗲𝗱 𝗞𝗶𝗻𝗴𝗱𝗼𝗺
Universidad de Dagupan (UdD) President Dr. Feliza Arzadon-Sua joined a courtesy call and meeting with Philippine Ambassador to the United Kingdom, Teodoro L. Locsin Jr., as part of the Philippine delegation's engagements in London. During the meeting, discussions centered on educational opportunities for Overseas Filipino Workers (OFWs) in the United Kingdom, particularly the Expanded Tertiary Education Equivalency and Accreditation Program (ETEEAP).
The program provides qualified working professionals with the opportunity to earn a college degree by recognizing their prior learning, work experience, and competencies. The meeting highlighted the importance of making higher education more accessible to Filipinos abroad and strengthening initiatives that support lifelong learning and professional advancement for OFWs.

SDG 17 - PARTNERSHIPS FOR THE GOALS
UdD Strengthens Global Reach Through MOU with National Chi Nan University of Taiwan
By UdD Staff
May 6, 2026
Share
𝗨𝗱𝗗 𝘀𝗶𝗴𝗻𝘀 𝗠𝗢𝗨 𝘄𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗡𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗖𝗵𝗶 𝗡𝗮𝗻 𝗨𝗻𝗶𝘃𝗲𝗿𝘀𝗶𝘁𝘆 𝗼𝗳 𝗧𝗮𝗶𝘄𝗮𝗻 Universidad de Dagupan (UdD) entered into a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) with National Chi Nan University today, marking a significant step in strengthening international academic collaboration. The signing took place during Day 1 of the 6th HLU Annual Conference, held alongside the 2026 WURI Global Rankings Ceremony from May 6–8.
The MOU establishes a framework for cooperation between the two institutions in areas such as joint research and academic activities, faculty and student exchanges, and the sharing of academic resources and research publications. It also opens opportunities for study tours, joint degree programs (subject to separate agreements), and broader multilateral collaborations. Representing UdD in this milestone engagement was Chief Operating Officer Jann Alfred Arzadon Quinto, who underscored the university’s commitment to expanding its global academic partnerships and enhancing the quality of education through international linkages.
The agreement aligns with both institutions’ shared vision of fostering innovation, academic excellence, and cross-cultural exchange. It also reflects a mutual commitment to inclusivity, equal opportunity, and collaborative growth in higher education. The joint event gathered more than 350 higher education leaders from across the globe, serving as a premier platform for discussions on university innovation, artificial intelligence transformation, sustainability, and global collaboration.
Through this partnership, UdD continues to position itself as an active participant in the global academic community.

SDG 1 - GOOD HEALTH AND WELL BEING
UDD Expands Community Care Through Medical Mission 2026
By UdD Staff
Mar 31, 2026
Share
Building on our promise to bring healthcare closer to home, the Universidad de Dagupan Medical Mission 2026 has officially come to life! Following our launch of "Alagang Pangkalusugan para sa Paaralan at Komunidad," this day stands as a heartfelt fulfillment of our commitment to the people of Dagupan. At the forefront of this mission, the 𝗖𝗮𝗺𝗽𝘂𝘀 𝗣𝗿𝗶𝗺𝗮𝗿𝘆 𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗽𝗼𝗻𝗱𝗲𝗿𝘀 (𝗖𝗣𝗥) took the lead, transforming our vision of "United for Health, Serving with Heart" into a reality through their dedicated leadership and technical expertise.
By bridging the gap between medical professionals and the community, the CPR—together with our faculty, students, and esteemed partners—ensured that every individual had access to vital free services. From medical consultations and essential medications to specialized ECGs, X-rays, eye check-ups, and the Yakap Program, the mission successfully catered to the diverse needs of our fellow Dagupeños. The inclusion of a blood donation drive and circumcision (tuli) services further emphasized our collective goal of promoting long-term wellness and saving lives.
This event was made possible through the unwavering support of the Region 1 Medical Center, Dagupan Doctors Villaflor Memorial Hospital, Philippine Red Cross, and our many dedicated partners and local leaders. More than just a one-day clinic, this initiative, spearheaded by the Campus Primary Responders, serves as a powerful movement of compassion. Together, we continue to prove that when we serve with purpose and care with heart, we truly heal as one.

SDG 8 - REDUCED INEQUALITIES
UdD is PWD Friendly
By UdD Staff
Sep 23, 2022
Share
By enhancing the facilities that meet their needs, UNIVERSIDAD DE DAGUPAN is facilitating the attendance of persons with disabilities (PWDs) in their classes.
PWD students and staff may now be easily transported across the UdD main campus thanks to upgraded wheelchair ramps, a new lifter, and an existing elevator. Similarly, PWD students and clients must have spaces and waiting areas in offices and student service centers.

By UdD Staff
Dec 22, 2023
Share
Universidad de Dagupan led by the Chairman of the board of trustees Dr. Voltaire P. Arzadon to witness the distribution of the donation for the selected families.

Update
UdD appoints Dr. Arzadon-Sua as new president
By Administrator
Mar 28, 2023
Share
UdD appoints Dr. Arzadon-Sua as new president
Dr. Feliza Arzadon-Sua has been appointed as the new president of Universidad de Dagupan taking over the position from her father, Dr. Voltaire P. Arzadon, who served the institution for 39 years.
Atty. Joseph Noel Estrada, UdD’s Legal counsel, awarded the appointment along with the Board of Trustees. While the University Medallion and Mace were handed by the 1st and outgoing president, Dr. Voltaire P. Arzadon.
Dr. Arzadon-Sua is the university’s first female president. She first served as an internal auditor and later became the Vice President for Administration and Vice President for Academic Affairs of the institution.
In her acceptance speech, Dr. Arzadon-Sua highlighted her goals for the institution namely, fostering meaningful connections, enriching learning and word environment, leveraging UdD’s strengths, implementing employment initiatives for graduates, encouraging zeal for service and administration, and achieving international and national distinctions.
The turnover and investiture ceremonies was held on March 23, 2023 at UdD-Arzadon Gymnasium, Leisure Coast Resort and were attended by different officials from CHED, DepEd, LGUs, members of the university administration, faculty, staff, and students.
The event set the beginning of a new chapter for Universidad de Dagupan.

Campus
UdD Celebrates 2nd Year as a University: Another Year of Recollection
By UdD Staff
December 18, 2023
Share
The University of Dagupan (UdD) marked a significant milestone last December 14, 2023, celebrating its second Uni-anniversary as a full-fledged university. This momentous occasion signifies not only the institution's continued growth and development but also the ongoing construction of a legacy of academic excellence and community engagement.
UdD's journey towards university status began in 1984, when it was established as “Computronix”. Over the years, the institution steadily expanded its academic offerings, research initiatives, and community outreach programs. This dedication to progress culminated in 2021 when UdD officially gained university status, marking a new chapter in its history.
The past two years have been a period of significant transformation for UdD. The university has implemented various initiatives to strengthen its academic programs, including the introduction of new degree courses, the expansion of research facilities, and the recruitment of highly qualified faculty members. Additionally, UdD has actively engaged with the local community through various outreach programs, fostering partnerships and contributing to the social and economic development of the region.
As UdD celebrates its second anniversary as a university, it stands poised for further growth and success. The campus buzzed with excitement as students, faculty, and staff came together for a whirlwind of festivities.
Booths proudly displayed student achievements and creativity, showcasing the university's vibrant academic and extracurricular life. Aromatics filled the air from a vast array of food stalls, offering a delicious feast for all. Stellar performances kept the energy high throughout the day, with talented students taking the stage and captivating the crowd.
But the undisputed highlight of the event was the Bandmania, the epic battle of the bands! Students from different school departments brought the house down with their musical prowess, raw energy, and fierce school spirit. In a thrilling competition, the School of Humanities (SOH) emerged victorious, solidifying their place as UdD's musical champions.The celebration was a resounding success, leaving everyone excited for the university's bright future.
The institution's commitment to academic excellence, community engagement, and innovation promises a bright future for UdD and its students. This anniversary serves as a testament to the hard work and dedication of the UdD community, and it marks the beginning of a new era for the university as it continues to build a strong and lasting legacy.
